notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.55

Insurance EOB: Record as - for Health Care Organizations

Each claim on the EOB can now be recorded as an AR payment, a Sales receipt, an Other deposit, or Leave out.
The Bulk Claim number is used as the reference number. Claims that are left out are listed in the lodgement memo.
Sales receipts can take a class for the whole receipt and for each line.
The EOB stays off until it is turned on in Settings (Insurance EOB).

Funds collected: deposits made in QuickBooks

“Also what was entered in QuickBooks” is now ticked by default when QuickBooks is connected.
The report now includes the direct lines of deposits made in QuickBooks (loans, refunds, transfers in), with the account each came from.

Payments inside a deposit, and lodgements sent from this app, are not counted twice.
New From account filter.

What’s new

New What’s new page in the user menu, showing every version’s changes and the update history.
After an update, each user sees a short note of what changed, once. It can be turned off in Settings (Show what’s new).
